065/**
066 * Used to synchronize a data navigator and a navigation ComboBox.
067 * The combobox may contain the original row number, see
068 * {@link DbSupport#createRownumQuery(String, String, String, String) },
069 * {@link SsDbComboBox2#setD2ColumnName(String)}
070 * and {@link #setComboHasRowNum(boolean)}<br>
071 * <b>Otherwise</b>: The SsDbComboBox2 and the RowSet queries should select the same
072records and in the same order; if not, the SSSyncManager will spend a lot of
073time looping through records to match.
074 *
075 * @param <K> java type of RowSet's key; same as {@literal <K>} in associated SsDbComboBox2
076 */
077public class SyncManager<K> {
078  /**
079   * Listener for combo box to update data navigator when combo box-based
080   * navigation occurs.
081   */
082  protected class SyncComboListener implements ActionListener {
083    // WHEN THERE IS A CHANGE IN THIS VALUE MOVE THE ROWSET SO THAT
084    // ITS POSITIONED AT THE RIGHT RECORD.
085    /** {@inheritDoc } */
086    @Override
087    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent ae) {
088      // Let the combo box close to avoid NetBeans breakpoint hang.
089      EventQueue.invokeLater(() -> handleComboEvent(ae));
090    }
091  } // protected class SyncComboListener implements ActionListener {
092
093  private int actionPerformedCount = 0;
094  private void handleComboEvent(@SuppressWarnings("unused") ActionEvent ae) {
095    if (!rowsModel.canNavigate()) {
096      logger.log(ERROR, "Attempting to navigate when canNavigate is false",
097                 new Exception("canNavigate false"));
098      return;
099    }
100
101    removeRowsetListener();
102    try {
103      rowsModel.rsOp(comboBox, () -> handleComboEvent01());
104    } catch (final SQLException se) {
105      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception.", se);
106    } finally {
107      logger.log(DEBUG,
108                 () -> sf("SyncComboListener actionPerformedCount=%s", actionPerformedCount++));
109      addRowsetListener();
110    }
111  }
112
113  K getSyncColumn() throws SQLException {
114    // This get not implemented yet from java's rowSetImpl
115    // getRowSet().getObject(syncColumnName, comboBox.getKeyType());
116
117    Object o = getRowSet().getObject(syncColumnName);
118    return ConvertType.convertToType(o, comboBox.getKeyType());
119  }
120
121  // direct use of getRowSet()
122  private void handleComboEvent01() throws SQLException {
123    // Nothing to do for an empty/null rowset.
124    if ((getRowSet() == null) || !rowsModel.containsRows()) {
125      return;
126    }
127
128    K comboPK = comboBox.getChosenKey();
129    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("COMBO NAVIGATOR: getChosenKey() returned: %s.", comboPK));
130
131    // getChosenKey() could return null during initialization.
132    // We check for null/empty rowset in the prior block.
133    if (comboPK == null) {
134      logger.log(WARNING, "Null selected in Combo Navigator.");
135      return;
136    }
137
138    // Note that the rowset count starts at 1 whereas combobox index starts at 0.
139
140    final K rowsetPK = getSyncColumn();
141
142    try {
143      if (comboPK != rowsetPK) {
144        // Update the present row before moving to another row.
145        // This code was removed to improve performance.
146        //
147        // 2020-12-02_BP: adding back
148        // 2021-02-26_BP: moving inside 'if (comboPK != rowsetPK) {' block
149        // TODO: does autocommit/canModify/dirty need to be checked?
150        rowsModel.commit();
151
152        final int guessRowNumber = comboHasRowNum ? ((Long) comboBox.getChosenD2()).intValue()
153                                                  : comboBox.getKeys().indexOf(comboPK) + 1;
154        logger.log(DEBUG,
155                   () -> sf("Rowset PK=%s, Combo PK=%s, Target rowset record # should be %s.",
156                            rowsetPK, comboPK, guessRowNumber));
157
158        getRowSet().absolute(guessRowNumber);
159
160        final int numRecords = comboBox.getItemCount();
161        int count = 0;
162
163        // If after positioning the rowset, the values
164        // don't match, perform a manual loop to try to find a match presuming
165        // records could be added/deleted by other connections, don't loop through
166        // all of the records more than once plus a cushion of "OFFSET_TO_CHECK"
167        while (comboPK != getSyncColumn()) {
168          if (!getRowSet().next()) {
169            getRowSet().beforeFirst();
170            getRowSet().next();
171          }
172
173          count++;
174
175          final int tcount = count;
176          logger.log(WARNING,
177                     () -> "SSSyncManager RowSet and DBComboBox2 values "
178                                + "do not match for the same index. This can be caused by "
179                                + "DBComboBox2 and RowSet queries not selecting the same "
180                                + "records in the same order. Looping through each record "
181                                + "for a match. Check # " + tcount + ".");
182
183          // Often records are just slightly out of order so a better
184          // strategy would be to move backwards by some small offset
185          // and then search forward rather than potentially searching
186          // through all records to make a full loop.
187          // TODO: sorting alphabetically things slightly out of order?
188          if (count == 1) {
189            // If there are only a few records, just start at first record
190            int rowsetSearchFrom = 1;
191
192            if (numRecords > OFFSET_TO_CHECK) {
193              rowsetSearchFrom = guessRowNumber - OFFSET_TO_CHECK;
194            }
195            if (rowsetSearchFrom < 1) {
196              rowsetSearchFrom += numRecords;
197            }
198            if (rowsetSearchFrom > numRecords) {
199              rowsetSearchFrom -= numRecords;
200            }
201            getRowSet().absolute(rowsetSearchFrom);
202          }
203
204          // number of items in combo is the number of records in resultset.
205          // so if for some reason item is in combo but deleted in rowset
206          // To avoid infinite loop in such scenario
207          if (count > (numRecords + OVERLAP_TO_CHECK)) {
208            // TODO: is this needed?
209            comboBox.repaint();
210            logger.log(WARNING,
211                       () -> sf("SSSyncManager unable to find a record matching"
212                                     + " the selection in the dropdown list: %s.",
213                                comboBox.getSelectedStringValue()));
214            // JOptionPane.showInternalMessageDialog(comboBox,
215            //      "Record deleted. Info the admin about this",
216            //      "Row not found",JOptionPane.OK_OPTION);
217            break;
218          }
219        }
220      }
221    } finally {
222      // TODO: would be nice not to need this; but...
223      // There is direct RowSet cursor positioning (not through RowsModel),
224      // so sync the RowsModel/spinner
225      rowsModel.syncRowNumber();
226    }
227  }
228
229  /**
230   * Listener for rowset.
231   */
232  protected class SyncRowSetListener implements RowSetListener {
233    /**
234     * variables needed to consolidate multiple calls
235     */
236    private int lastChange = 0;
237    private int lastNotifiedChange = 0;
238
239    /**
240     * {@inheritDoc}
241     */
242    @Override
243    public void cursorMoved(RowSetEvent event) {
244      logger.log(TRACE, "Rowset cursor moved.");
245      performUpdates();
246    }
247
248    /**
249     * {@inheritDoc}
250     */
251    @Override
252    public void rowChanged(RowSetEvent rse) {
253      logger.log(TRACE, "Rowset row changed.");
254      // Do nothing as there is no navigation involved
255      //performUpdates();
256    }
257
258    /**
259     * {@inheritDoc}
260     */
261    @Override
262    public void rowSetChanged(RowSetEvent rse) {
263      logger.log(TRACE, "Rowset changed.");
264      performUpdates();
265    }
266
267    private void performUpdates() {
268      lastChange++;
269      logger.log(TRACE,
270                 () -> sf("performUpdates(): lastChange=%s, lastNotifiedChange=%s", lastChange,
271                          lastNotifiedChange));
272
273      // Delay execution of logic until all listener methods are called for current event
274      // Based on: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3953208/value-change-listener-to-jtextfield
275      SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
276        if (lastNotifiedChange != lastChange) {
277          lastNotifiedChange = lastChange;
278
279          adjustValue();
280        }
281      });
282    }
283  }
284
285  /**
286   * Method to update combo box based on rowset.
287   */
288  protected void adjustValue() {
289    //      // Ignore rowset listener calls triggered during row insertion or while navigator is calling updateRow() on rowset.
290    //      if (dataNavigator.isOnInsertRow()) {
291    //          return;
292    //      }
293
294    removeComboListener();
295
296    try {
297      if ((getRowSet() != null) && (getRowSet().getRow() > 0)) {
298        // GET THE PRIMARY KEY FOR THE CURRENT RECORD IN THE ROWSET
299        final K currentRowPK = getSyncColumn();
300
301        logger.log(DEBUG,
302                   () -> sf("SSSyncManager().adjustValue() - RowSet value: %s", currentRowPK));
303
304        // CHECK IF THE COMBO BOX IS DISPLAYING THE SAME ONE.
305        if ((comboBox.getSelectedStringValue() == null)
306            || !Objects.equals(comboBox.getChosenKey(), currentRowPK)) {
307          // IF NOT CHANGE THE SELECTION OF THE COMBO BOX.
308          // this.comboBox.setSelectedStringValue(this.rowset.getString(this.columnName));
309          comboBox.setChosenKey(currentRowPK);
310        }
311      } else {
312        //comboBox.setSelectedIndex(-1);
313        comboBox.setChosenKey(null);
314      }
315    } catch (final SQLException se) {
316      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception.", se);
317    }
318
319    comboBox.setEnabled(true);
320    addComboListener();
321  }

323  /** Logger for component */
324  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
325
326  /**
327   * # of records to step back if doing a sequential search because
328SsDbComboBox2 and RowSet results don't match.
329   */
330  private static final int OFFSET_TO_CHECK = 7;
331
332  /**
333   * # of records of overlap to check if SsDbComboBox2 and RowSet results
334don't match due to record additions/deletions.
335   */
336  private static final int OVERLAP_TO_CHECK = 7;
337
338  /** SsDbComboBox2 used for record navigation. */
339  private SsDbComboBox2<K, ?, ?> comboBox;
340
341  /** Listener on combo box to detect combo-based navigations. */
342  private final SyncComboListener comboListener = new SyncComboListener();
343
344  /** Indicates if combo navigator listener is added (or removed) */
345  private boolean comboListenerAdded = false;
346
347  private RowsModel rowsModel;
348
349  /** Listener on RowSet to detect data navigator-based navigations. */
350  private final SyncRowSetListener rowsetListener = new SyncRowSetListener();
351
352  /** Indicates if rowset listener is added (or removed) */
353  private boolean rowsetListenerAdded = false;
354
355  /** RowSet column used as basis for synchronization. */
356  private boolean comboHasRowNum;
357
358  /** RowSet column used as basis for synchronization. */
359  private String syncColumnName;
360
361  /**
362   * Creates a SSSyncManager with the specified combo box and data navigator.
363   *
364   * @param comboBox   SsDbComboBox2 used for record navigation
365   * @param rowsModel  RowsModel to synchronize with navigation combo box
366   */
367  @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
368  public SyncManager(SsDbComboBox2<K, ?, ?> comboBox, RowsModel rowsModel) {
369    this.comboBox = comboBox;
370    this.rowsModel = rowsModel;
371    rowsModel.setNavCombo(comboBox, this);
372    if (comboBox.getLogColumnName() == null) {
373      comboBox.setLogColumnName(sf("**ComboBoxNavigator@%x**", System.identityHashCode(comboBox)));
374    }
375  }
376
377  /**
378   * Set the rowSet's column name to use as a basis for synchronization
379   * with the the comboBox item's key.
380   *
381   * @param syncColumnName RowSet column used as basis for synchronization.
382   */
383  // TODO: put in constructor?
384  public void setSyncColumnName(String syncColumnName) {
385    this.syncColumnName = syncColumnName;
386  }

388  /**
389   * Set this to true if the combobox item element has the rownumber
390   * of the RowSet in {@code <D2>}.
391   * @param comboHasRowNum
392   */
393  public void setComboHasRowNum(boolean comboHasRowNum) {
394    this.comboHasRowNum = comboHasRowNum;

396
397  /**
398   * Stop synchronization between navigation components.
399   */
400  public void async() {
401    logger.log(DEBUG, "");
402    removeListeners();
403  }
404
405  /**
406   * Start synchronization between navigation components.
407   *
408   * This aligns the combo navigator with the data navigator and turns on the listeners.
409   */
410  public void sync() {
411    // 2020-12-02_BP:
412    //   Seems we should adjustValue() and then call addListeners() because adjustValue() starts by removing the combo listener.
413    //   However since adjustValue() was removing/adding the combo listener, it was getting called twice.
414    //   Added methods for adding/removing combo and rowset listeners along with booleans to indicate state.
415    logger.log(DEBUG, "");
416    adjustValue();
417    addListeners();
418  }

442  private RowSet getRowSet() {
443    return rowsModel.getRowSet();
444  }
445
446  /**
447   * Adds listeners to combobox & rowset.
448   */
449  private void addListeners() {
450    addComboListener();
451    addRowsetListener();
452  }
453
454  /**
455   * Removes listeners from combobox & rowset.
456   */
457  private void removeListeners() {
458    removeComboListener();
459    removeRowsetListener();
460  }
461
462  /**
463   * Adds listener to the combo navigator
464   */
465  private void addComboListener() {
466    if (!comboListenerAdded) {
467      comboBox.addActionListener(comboListener);
468      comboListenerAdded = true;
469    }
470  }
471
472  /**
473   * Removes listener from the combo navigator
474   */
475  private void removeComboListener() {
476    if (comboListenerAdded) {
477      comboBox.removeActionListener(comboListener);
478      comboListenerAdded = false;
479    }
480  }
481
482  /**
483   * Adds listener to the rowset
484   */
485  private void addRowsetListener() {
486    if (!rowsetListenerAdded) {
487      getRowSet().addRowSetListener(rowsetListener);
488      rowsetListenerAdded = true;
489    }
490  }
491
492  /**
493   * Removes listener from the rowset
494   */
495  private void removeRowsetListener() {
496    if (rowsetListenerAdded) {
497      getRowSet().removeRowSetListener(rowsetListener);
498      rowsetListenerAdded = false;
499    }
500  }
